ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels to 15% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and fluke tips. Focal black clusters and mottling are localized around the median notch and scattered sporadically across the central white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle approximately 35-45 degrees with significant pixel depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 20 units. Distinct jagged peaks are visible on the distal segments of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; exhibiting concave curvature near the peduncle/median notch transitioning to a pronounced convex sweep toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible on the mid-lobe of the right fluke and near the lower-central splash boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented inward from the trailing edge on the left lobe; additional finer, unaligned scratches are visible on the interior surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring on the left lobe surface; minor irregular indentation or missing tissue segment on the trailing edge of the left fluke lobe near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of fine, dark vertical striations on the interior white field of the left lobe.
